kitchenCapacity.desc: The most items your kitchen can turn out at once, across all the categories you've ticked. Each category's own batch size still applies on top.
kitchenCapacity.example: Example: if you can cook 4 mains in 5 minutes, then set it to 4 items every 5 minutes. The total capacity limits orders across all selected categories so if you want to only sell a maximum of 10 starters and mains every 5 minutes, then set Total Capacity to 10 items every 5 minutes and select Starters and Mains tickbox. This will still keep your mains restricted to 4 items every 5 minutes.
kitchenCapacity.instantNote: Instant items don't count towards kitchen capacity — customers receive them immediately.
kitchenCapacity.warning: ⚠️ For kitchen capacity to work properly, set a prep time and batch size on your menu categories (Menu & Stock). Without them, capacity can't tell how long items take to cook.

manageAllergens.wizard.cardPanel.intro: Customers will see this card as the menu's allergen reference. Per-dish allergens stay hidden in card-only mode (your dish data is kept for if you switch to per-dish later).

manageExtras.option.allergensHelp: This option's own allergens (separate from the dish)

manageMenu.category.prepHelp: Set to Instant for items like drinks or dips. These won't count toward kitchen capacity.

manageMenu.deleteItem.body: This item will be hidden from your menu immediately. It won't appear on the customer order page or in the Add Order panel.
manageMenu.empty.note: Works with photos, screenshots, PDFs and plain text. You can review and edit everything before it's saved.
manageMenu.item.noGroups: No option groups yet — create them in Extras & Upsells.
manageMenu.newCategory.notesHelp: Lets customers add a note to each item (e.g. "no onion"). The truck can always add item notes regardless. All orders also have an order-level notes field.

manageScheduleVerify.blockedDomain: Please use your website URL — Facebook and Instagram pages can't be scraped automatically.
manageScheduleVerify.malformed: That doesn't look like a web address. Try something like yourtruck.co.uk/events
manageScheduleVerify.no_content: We reached this page but couldn't read anything on it. Check it's publicly accessible.
manageScheduleVerify.no_events: We couldn't find any upcoming events on this page. Make sure the URL points directly to where your schedule is listed.
manageScheduleVerify.unreachable: We couldn't reach this website. It may be down, or the address may be wrong.
manageSettings.collection.help: How far apart collection times are. This doesn't change kitchen capacity or prep times.
manageSettings.collection.misaligned: {name} takes {mins} minutes to cook, so some times between batches will show as full.
manageSettings.contact.title: Contact Details
manageSettings.orders.emailNotifications: {hasEmail, select, yes {When on, an email is sent to {email} for every new order. Customer order emails are sent either way.} other {When on, an email is sent to the truck's contact email for every new order. Customer order emails are sent either way.}}
manageSettings.preorders.approvalHelp: Customers can still order, but the order needs your approval (won't auto-accept).
manageSettings.preorders.soldOutHelp: Customers can't order it after the deadline.
manageSettings.qr.noUrl: No order URL — slug not set
manageSettings.removeVan.removedLink: ✕ Removed: The van's kitchen screen link and settings will be deactivated.
manageSettings.schedule.autoDesc: Tell us where you post your schedule and we'll check it for you, sending any events we find for your approval. This needs to be your own website — not a Facebook or Instagram page.
manageSettings.schedule.checkingHelp: This can take up to 2 minutes — please keep this page open and don't close the tab.
manageSettings.schedule.eitherWay: Either way, if we find your events listed elsewhere, we'll still send these to you for approval. Nothing goes live until you confirm it.
manageSettings.vans.takesCashHelp: Splits the payment button into "Cash" and "Card" so your takings reconcile against the till. You can turn this on for a single event from the dashboard.
nativeShell.setup.noVanBody: This truck has no active van yet. Activate one in Settings → Vans, then this device sets up automatically — no further steps here.
offlineProtection.modes.no_auto_accept.h: Auto-accept is turned off, so customers can still order but nothing is confirmed automatically. You'll confirm each one when you're back online — and anything still waiting is rejected automatically after your selected time, with the customer emailed to let them know.
offlineProtection.modes.pause.help: Customers can't order until you're back online.
offlineProtection.modes.pause.label: Pause Online Ordering
offlineProtection.purpose: If your device loses its connection, this stops orders arriving while you can't see them.
serviceSettings.eventTypesFooterOneEvent: To change a setting for one event only, use that event's dashboard.
serviceSettings.sameSettingsConfirm: Copy Van 1's settings to every van? This copies all of Van 1's van settings, the same as 'Same as Van 1' in Settings. Kitchen capacity has its own switch.
tradeArea.country_off: Trucks can't sign up in {country} yet. Choose another country.
